name: Living Room Glass Door Treatments
subtitle: Farmhouse window treatment redesign
displayTitle: LIVING ROOM — GLASS DOOR WINDOW TREATMENTS
lede: Replace the existing roller shades with a higher-end farmhouse treatment that works with the four-panel glass door system and the entertainment center obstruction.
nextAction: Choose the final treatment direction, with ceiling-track linen drapery currently the strongest candidate, then confirm measurements and stacking clearance.
goals: Create a polished, high-end farmhouse look appropriate for a luxury home
Preserve easy access through the operating glass doors
Avoid interference with the entertainment center
Keep the room bright while providing useful privacy and sun control

siteConstraints.opening: Four glass panels total: two fixed panels and two operating door panels.
siteConstraints.existingTreatment: Roller shades came with the house.
siteConstraints.obstruction: The entertainment center now prevents the existing roller shades from coming all the way down.
siteConstraints.designStyle: Warm, elevated farmhouse / organic farmhouse rather than rustic farmhouse.
siteConstraints.accessRequirement: Any new treatment must stack or move clear of the two operating door panels.

budget.note: Budget will be set after the final treatment type and measurements are chosen.

phases.name: Existing Condition + Constraints
phases.summary: Document the existing roller shades, entertainment-center interference and four-panel door configuration.
requirements: Existing roller shades cannot fully lower because of the entertainment center

phases.name: Choose Window Treatment
phases.summary: Select a luxury farmhouse treatment that clears the entertainment center and keeps the operating doors functional.
requirements: Do not block access through the two operating door panels
Allow the treatment to stack outside the active doorway when open
Coordinate with the room's neutral palette, plants, light flooring and warm wood accents

phases.name: Measure + Final Specification
phases.summary: Measure the full opening, ceiling height, entertainment-center projection and available stack-back space before ordering.
requirements: Measure full wall/opening width and finished height
Measure each of the four glass panels
Confirm which two panels operate and their travel direction
Measure entertainment-center depth/projection into the shade path
Confirm left and right stack-back space
Choose fabric, lining, header/track and privacy level

phases.name: Purchase + Installation
phases.summary: Order the selected treatment and install it so all door functions remain unobstructed.
requirements: Install track/hardware level and high on the wall or ceiling as specified
Test full opening and closing of both operating doors
Confirm fabric/panels clear the entertainment center

decisions.decision: Likely not workable for this opening.
The current roller shades no longer work because the entertainment center prevents them from lowering fully.
Viable and currently the strongest candidate. Use a custom-looking warm ivory/oatmeal fabric with a tailored header and enough stack-back to fully clear the operating doors.
Still a viable alternative if the panels can stack fully clear of the operating door area.
Potential option only if the shades are reconfigured so they do not repeat the current entertainment-center interference problem.

maintenance.task: Vacuum or lightly dust fabric/panels and track hardware
Check track alignment, carriers and door clearance
